jobDescription:
Job Description

Position: Partnership Operations Manager (Co-Lending & Insurance Operations)

Organisation: Clix Capital Services Pvt. Ltd.

About the Role

The Partnership Operations Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end operations for strategic partnerships across Co-Lending, Insurance, Banking, Fintech, and Embedded Finance ecosystems. The role focuses on seamless execution of operational processes, partner servicing, regulatory compliance, digital integrations, and customer lifecycle management while ensuring adherence to agreed SLAs and regulatory requirements.

The incumbent will play a key role in driving operational excellence across Co-Lending Operations, Insurance Operations, Partner Management, Compliance, and Back-End Servicing functions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Partnership Operations Execution (Co-Lending & Insurance Operations)

Co-Lending Operations

•Manage end-to-end co-lending operations including onboarding, loan origination, disbursement, servicing, collections support, reconciliations, and closure activities.

•Possess strong understanding of Loan Origination Systems (LOS) and Loan Management Systems (LMS).

•Coordinate with lending partners, banks, financial institutions, and internal stakeholders for smooth operations.

•Manage operational workflows for co-lending programs and ensure adherence to partner SLAs.

•Monitor repayment processing, foreclosure, settlements, reconciliation, and partner reporting.

•Understand RBI Co-Lending Guidelines and ensure process compliance.

Insurance Operations

•Manage end-to-end insurance operations across life, health, and general insurance products sourced through partnership channels.

•Oversee policy issuance, endorsements, cancellations, renewals, claims coordination, refunds, reconciliation, and partner servicing.

•Coordinate with insurers, TPAs, brokers, and internal teams for seamless policy administration.

•Ensure compliance with IRDAI guidelines and operational controls.

•Drive customer servicing activities related to insurance products and policy lifecycle management.

•Monitor insurance partner SLAs, commission payouts, invoicing, and reconciliation.

Partnership Management

•Manage operational relationships with co-lending partners, insurance companies, banks, fintech partners, aggregators, and service providers.

•Own and drive operational governance forums and partner review meetings.

•Liaise with partners and internal stakeholders (Business, Risk, Finance, Legal, Technology, QA, Compliance, and Operations) to ensure business continuity and growth.

•Support new partnership onboarding, process setup, UAT execution, and post-implementation stabilization.

2. Operations Excellence & Process Management

•Identify opportunities for automation, digitisation, and process improvements.

•Design and implement scalable operational processes and controls.

•Lead process gathering exercises, workflow creation, system enhancements, and operational developments.

•Draft SOPs, process notes, and operational governance frameworks.

•Create end-to-end digital customer journeys and support API integrations with partner ecosystems.

•Drive operational efficiency through data analysis and industry best practices.

•Manage operational risks through structured maker-checker-authoriser frameworks.

3. Compliance, Regulatory & Audit Management

•Ensure adherence to RBI, IRDAI, Compliance, Legal, and Information Security requirements.

•Coordinate internal, external, regulatory, and partner audits.

•Manage audit observations, closure tracking, and compliance reporting.

•Support RBI and IRDAI regulatory filings and query resolution.

•Ensure all customer communications, operational processes, and partner engagements comply with applicable regulations.

•Manage partner agreements from an operational governance perspective.

•Keep updated on regulatory developments impacting lending, insurance, and partnership businesses.

4. Back-End Servicing & Partner Support

•Responsible for management reporting, MIS, operational dashboards, and ad-hoc business reporting.

•Coordinate with Customer Service teams for customer issue resolution and escalations.

•Address partner operational queries, data requests, and reconciliation issues.

•Handle partner adjudication and exception management processes.

•Manage partner, insurer, and co-lender commission calculations, invoice validations, and payment processes.

•Oversee operational reconciliations across lending, insurance, collections, repayments, and partner settlements.

•Ensure accurate maintenance of partner and customer records.


Competencies

•Strong understanding of Co-Lending Operations, Insurance Operations, and Partner Management.

•Knowledge of Loan Management Systems (LMS), Loan Origination Systems (LOS), and Insurance Administration Systems.

•Understanding of RBI Co-Lending Guidelines and IRDAI regulations.

•Expertise in operational workflow creation and process optimisation.

•Experience managing operational partnerships within NBFCs, Banks, Insurance Companies, Fintechs, or Financial Institutions.

•Knowledge of repayment processing, EMI management, foreclosure, settlements, and reconciliations.

•Strong governance, compliance, and audit management skills.

•Excellent stakeholder management and negotiation capabilities.

•Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.

•Experience leading teams and managing cross-functional operations.

•Advanced MS Excel and reporting capabilities.

•Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced and evolving business environment.

Desired Credentials

•Graduate/Post Graduate in Business, Finance, Banking, Insurance, or related discipline.

•Minimum 3+ years of experience in Partnership Operations, Co-Lending Operations, Insurance Operations, Banking Operations, or NBFC Operations.

•Prior experience with NBFCs, Banks, Insurance Companies, Fintechs, or Financial Services organisations preferred.

•Experience in managing multiple partnerships and high-volume operational environments will be an added advantage.

Preferred Experience

•Co-Lending Operations

•Insurance Servicing & Policy Administration

•Bancassurance / Corporate Agency Operations

•Banking & Payments Operations

•Partner Reconciliation & Settlement Management

•Regulatory Compliance (RBI/IRDAI)

•Digital Transformation & Partner Integration Programs

Job Purpose:

To manage the Post Disbursement Documents (PDD) function, ensuring timely collection, verification, and closure of all required documents post loan disbursement, while maintaining compliance with internal policies and regulatory norms. Candidate will ensure operational accuracy, contribute to risk mitigation, customer satisfaction and coordination with stakeholders.


Key RESPONSIBILITIES:


Documentation & System Process:

•Collect and verify post-disbursement documents of loan account.

•Ensure proper indexing / storage & retrieval / refilling of original documents.

•Monitor timelines for document submission and escalate delays.

•Track document pendency and initiate follow-ups.

•Ensure accurate tagging of borrower/property details.

Regulatory & Compliance:

•Coordinate with legal, credit, sales, and technical teams.

•Liaise with external Vendors (Storage, E-Agreement etc.).

•RBI KYC norms – PAN, Aadhaar, address proof validation and c KYC processing.

•SARFAESI Act – Proper charge creation and registration.

•Regulatory Reporting – Accurate and timely updates and support audit.

Risk/Quality Control & Reporting/MIS:

•Identify and escalate documentation discrepancies.

•Ensure safekeeping of original documents in FRFC storage.

•Participate in process improvement and automation initiatives.

•Prepare MIS reports on document pendency, compliance status, and exceptions.

•Support internal/external audits with required documentation.


Qualifications, Experience & Competencies:

•Graduate/Postgraduate in Commerce, Finance, or related field.

•4-5 years of experience and strong understanding of Operations, Disbursement, PDD management, Property Papers preferably in an NBFC or BFSI environment.

•Prior experience in managing audits and regulatory compliance is a plus (RBI, NHB, SARFAESI).

•Proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, data analysis and familiarity with loan origination & management systems (e.g., Finn One, Pennant)

16. Passion for numbers, meticulous attention to details and bringing insights of business value

17. Comfortable with ambiguity and skilled at translating broad ideas into actionable plans.

18. Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to analyze and solve complex problems.

19. Strong communication skills to effectively communicate solutions in a simple and concise manner.

title: Manager - Operations
jobDescription:
Role Overview

The role will be responsible for managing end-to-end repayment and EMI operations, including EMI presentation cycles, NACH/PDC/SPDC processes, payment tracking, and system application. The incumbent will also manage vendor operations for dispatch and retrieval of instruments, ensuring strong controls, accuracy, and timely execution.

Key Responsibilities

Repayment & EMI Operations

•Manage the complete EMI presentation cycle, covering:

o Presentation of NACH, PDC, and SPDC as per defined schedules

o Coordination with banks, clearing houses, and internal systems for timely presentation

•Oversee end-to-end NACH lifecycle, including registration, modification, presentation, re-presentation, and closures.

•Monitor and resolve EMI returns / bounces, NACH failures, and representation cases.

•Handle NACH migration activities, including bank/platform changes and mandate transfers.

•Track payment realisation status for NACH/PDC/SPDC presentations.

•Ensure accurate and timely payment application in the system, including:

o EMI posting

o Excess/short payment handling

o Reconciliation and exception resolution

•Manage auto lease payment application and address system or operational mismatches.

Vendor Management

•Manage vendors responsible for dispatch, presentation support, and retrieval of physical instruments (PDC/SPDC/NACH mandates).

•Validate vendor MIS reports and invoices; ensure SLA and TAT adherence.

•Drive resolution of operational issues, escalations, and service gaps with vendors.

Controls, Compliance & MIS

•Ensure adherence to RBI/banking guidelines, internal policies, and SOPs related to EMI and repayment operations.

•Prepare and maintain daily/monthly MIS, reconciliation statements, and control dashboards.

•Support internal and external audits by providing data, explanations, and documentation.

•Identify process gaps and drive process improvements and automation initiatives in repayment and EMI cycles.

Desired Candidate Profile

Qualifications

•Graduate in any discipline (MBA / Finance preferred).

Experience

•2–7 years of experience in Banking/NBFC Operations, specifically in repayments and EMI management.

•Hands-on exposure to EMI presentation (NACH/PDC/SPDC), payment tracking, and system application is mandatory.

•Experience in vendor coordination and bank interactions is essential.

Skills & Competencies

•Strong understanding of EMI lifecycle, repayment instruments, and banking operations.

•High attention to detail with a strong control and compliance orientation.

•Strong Excel/MIS and reconciliation skills.

•Ability to handle high transaction volumes and tight timelines.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

•EMI presentation accuracy and success rate

•Reduction in bounce/reject cases

•Timely and accurate payment application

•Vendor SLA adherence

•Audit observations and reconciliation breaks

title: Manager - Risk Analytics
jobDescription:
Key RESPONSIBILITIES:

Portfolio & Risk Analytics

Conduct portfolio quality analysis across products (Business Loan, LAP, School Finance, Business Loan, PL etc).

Perform Early Warning Signal (EWS) tracking and trend analysis.

Collaborate with Business & Credit teams for portfolio actions and insights.

ECL & ICAAP

Own and update the Expected Credit Loss (ECL) model assumptions, documentation, and reporting.

Support in preparation of ICAAP (Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process) including capital computation, stress testing, and related risk parameters.

Policy & Governance

Lead periodic review and updation of credit risk policies with relevant data support.

Benchmark internal frameworks with regulatory and industry practices.

Stakeholder & Investor Interaction

Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders (e.g., investors, auditors, rating agencies) for data requirements, portfolio presentations, and Q&A support.

Scorecard & Data Science Collaboration

Work with the Data Science team to co-develop, test, and refine credit scorecards.

Validate performance metrics and ensure proper business integration of models.

Dashboards & Reporting

Design and monitor risk dashboards, MIS, and review decks for internal governance forums (Risk Committee, Board Risk Committee).

Ensure timely and accurate reporting for senior management.

Key Skills & QUALIFICATIONS:

Postgraduate in Finance, Statistics, Economics, or equivalent. (FRM/CFA is a plus.)

Strong analytical skills with experience in SAS, SQL, Python, or Excel-based modeling.

Working knowledge of ECL, Basel II/III, RBI guidelines, and credit risk frameworks.

Ability to manage multiple stakeholders, synthesize data, and present actionable insights.

Prior experience in NBFC, Bank, or Fintech risk functions preferred.

title: SSM-K12 D2C-North
jobDescription:
Role Summary

We are seeking a Senior Sales Manager – D2C to lead and scale direct-to-consumer sales for K12 school fee loan products. The role will focus on driving disbursals through digital and partner-led channels, managing sales teams, and building a scalable sales engine.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own end-to-end D2C sales lifecycle from lead conversion to loan disbursal
  • Achieve monthly and quarterly disbursal and revenue targets
  • Manage and optimize digital and offline leads via CRM/LMS
  • Build, mentor, and manage a team of inside sales/RMs
  • Monitor sales performance, productivity, and conversion metrics
  • Collaborate with marketing, credit, and operations to reduce TAT and fallouts
  • Engage with K12 schools and education partners to increase adoption
  • Ensure compliance with credit, KYC, and regulatory norms

Candidate Profile

  • Strong experience in D2C lending sales (education loans/consumer loans preferred)
  • Proven team-handling and target achievement capability
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills
  • Experience in fintech/NBFC environment preferred

Success Metrics

  • Consistent target achievement
  • High conversion efficiency
  • Scalable and compliant D2C sales operations

jobDescription:
Sales Manager – School Loans (Direct Sales)

The Sales Manager – School Loans (Direct Sales) is responsible for driving business growth by sourcing school loan opportunities through direct engagement with educational institutions. The role focuses on building a strong pipeline by identifying, onboarding, and nurturing relationships with private schools, school chains, trusts, and education societies.

The incumbent will proactively conduct field visits to meet school promoters, trustees, principals, and management teams to understand their funding requirements related to infrastructure development, expansion, working capital, or asset acquisition. The Sales Manager will position tailored school loan solutions, explain product features, pricing, and terms, and guide customers through the end-to-end loan process.

Key responsibilities include generating leads through direct market mapping, cold visits, referrals, and local networking, ensuring achievement of disbursement and revenue targets. The role requires close coordination with credit, legal, and operations teams to facilitate timely collection of documents, preliminary credit assessment, loan sanctioning, and disbursement. The Sales Manager will also support credit teams by providing on-ground insights into the school’s operations, reputation, and cash flow dynamics.

Post-disbursement, the Sales Manager will maintain ongoing relationships with schools to ensure customer satisfaction, monitor repayment behavior, and identify repeat or cross-sell opportunities. Ensuring portfolio quality, adherence to internal policies, and compliance with regulatory guidelines is a critical aspect of the role.

The ideal candidate should have strong relationship management skills, knowledge of education-sector lending, and hands-on experience in direct sales within NBFCs, banks, or fintech lending organizations.

title: Senior Manager - Marketing & Communication
jobDescription:
Role Overview

Senior Manager - Marketing & Communications will lead Clix Capital’s brand, PR/Media, and internal marketing initiatives. This role is responsible for driving measurable outcomes across PR, digital marketing, internal communications, and customer experience, while ensuring operational efficiency and alignment with business goals.

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Marketing & Brand Management

· Develop and execute integrated marketing strategies aligned with business objectives.

· Ensure marketing spends remain within approved budgets and deliver high ROI.

· Drive brand visibility through digital media, influencer campaigns, and hyper-local activations.

· Expand Clix’s footprint across new geographies with tailored marketing support.

Public Relations & Media Engagement

· Generate significant PR value through earned media and strategic storytelling.

· Build and maintain strong relationships with media agencies and external partners.

· Ensure timely and impactful representation of Clix leadership across industry forums.

Digital & Social Media Leadership

· Supervise and grow Clix’s social media presence, especially Linked In, to achieve 3x engagement.

· Monitor and optimize digital campaigns to deliver >1 million impressions.

· Evaluate and implement new Marcom tools to enhance creative output and team productivity.

Internal Communications & Collaboration

· Foster open, timely, and effective communication across departments.

· Support other functions with marketing visibility through internal branding (emails, TV screens, etc.).

· Promote cross-functional collaboration by encouraging team participation in strategic projects.

Customer Experience & Process Excellence

· Ensure timely support to internal stakeholders and external agencies.

· Drive process excellence to deliver a seamless experience for internal and external customers.

· Oversee the launch and optimization of the corporate website to enhance online trust.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

· NPS Score & Rating Agency Metrics

· Social Media Growth & Brand Impressions

· Internal Communication Effectiveness

Required Skills & Competencies

· Atleast 7+ yrs of overall Marketing experience with high exposure to digital marketing, PR, and branding

· MBA with certificate in Design & Creative Skills with prior experience in BFSI industry will be highly preferred

· Prior exposure to usage of AI in Marketing/ Creative Trends

· Digital Performance Marketing Expertise with knowledge of all Marketing Tools

· Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment with strong Collaboration/Stakeholder management
